description: Vong doi PHIEN DANG NHAP (session lifecycle) cua 1 tai khoan nguoi dung: 'logged_out' (chua dang nhap, cong khai) -> 'authenticating' (dang xac thuc, trang thai TAM THOI) -> hoac 'logged_in' (xac thuc thanh cong) hoac quay lai 'logged_out' (sai mat khau); tu 'logged_in' co the -> 'session_expired' (phien het han tu nhien) hoac -> 'locked' (tai khoan bi khoa, vd sau qua nhieu lan nhap sai o 1 phien khac). Day la VI DU KHONG CO TINH CHAT DONG THOI/TRANH CHAP (khac han cac vi du mutex/producer-consumer o tren) — muc dich chinh la minh hoa CTL tren 1 VONG DOI DON GIAN (single-entity lifecycle), thuong gap khi dac ta yeu cau nghiep vu (business logic) hon la he thong dong thoi.
